samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>Accumulator module to accumulate incoming 8-bit data inputs into 10-bit output data after receiving 4 inputs.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Input signal indicating readiness for new data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        Sequential logic block triggered on the rising edge of clk or active low reset rst_n.
        When valid_in is 1, data_in is considered a valid input.
        Accumulate four valid input data_in values and calculate the output data_out by adding these four values together.
        There is no output when there are fewer than four data_in inputs in the interim.
        Along with the output data_out, a cycle of valid_out=1 will appear as a signal.
        The valid_out signal is set to 1 when the data_out outputs 4 received data accumulation results. Otherwise, it is set to 0.
    </implementation>
</module>
